entries.label: approve_managed_qdrant_runtime
entries.title: Operate local Qdrant through the managed runtime and resync after backend changes
entries.summary: For the current ECITR semantic prototype, run Qdrant through the managed local helper and resync the derived index after backend changes.
entries.action: Run Qdrant through the managed local runtime helper, verify status serially, then resync the derived collection and rerun the semantic benchmark after backend or index-shape changes.
prerequisites: Qdrant binary is installed under the managed local runtime path
steps: Start Qdrant through the managed runtime command
Wait for a serial healthy status check before issuing sync
Run the catalog sync against the derived collection
Rerun the semantic benchmark after the sync completes
fallbacks: If the managed runtime cannot start, stop the process, inspect logs, and restart through the managed helper only
rollback: Revert the backend change before rerunning sync

entries.label: block_mismatched_runtime_and_operator_surface
entries.title: One tactic should cover both Qdrant runtime and morning review projection
entries.summary: Deliberate mismatch across unrelated operational procedures.
entries.action: Start Qdrant locally and rebuild the morning review surface from persisted artifacts in one tactic.
prerequisites: Runtime and operator surfaces both exist
